title: North Cabrillo Avenue / Channel Street / Miraflores Avenue / Temporary Closure Alley
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Engineer be instructed to report with recommendations to temporarily close the alley on North Cabrillo Avenue between Channel Street and Miraflores Avenue, pursuant to California Vehicle Code Section 21101.4. PRESENTED BY: L V TIM McOSKER Councilmember, 15th District H22 muss SECONDED BY:
